page.layout: One column of running text; a centred chapter heading and a italic argument summary below it; a large woodcut initial paragraph at the foot; a marginal note at the right end of the last line. No margin notes beside the body text.

main_text.p: cro exponentes ac definientes inducat ʔ Apage Turriani & Bovii, hominum nudiustertius natorum, adhæc ingenio fabularum ac quisquiliarum avidissimo, nuperamusteaque judicia. Quasi vero duobus istis heroibus hanc felicitatem fata servaverint, ut quæ omnis Latinorum Ecclesia totis quindecim sæculis vel plane penitusque nescivit, vel certe cognita contempsit ac nihili fecit, isti ultimis demum his temporibus inusitata spiritus copia perfusi, vera genuinaque Apostolorum dictata esse agnoverint, ac orbi Occidentali manifestarint.Nobis satis sunt,quæ ab initio toti Ecclesiæ tradita,toti agnita, Apostolorum monumenta in publica apud Occidentem æquè ac apud Orientem luce extiterunt.Ista tam sero ab hominibus novis, & quidem merito suspectis, revelata, apocrypha,, ut fuerant hactenus, ita quoque deinceps sunto.
main_text.head: CAP. II.
main_text.p: Æthiopum de Constitutionibus error, eas divinis libris æquiparantium. Græcorum de iis judicia. Epiphanio memoratas Constitutiones, neque nostras fuisse, neque vere ab Apostolis conditas.
ÆC de Latinis hactenus. Nunc cæteras Ecclesiæ Christianæ partes videamus. Idem ille Bellarminus

page.notes: The first word of the final paragraph is a large woodcut initial H, read as H; the words "ÆC de" are the start of "Hæc de". The word "nus" at the lower right is a catchword-like fragment of a marginal reference and is set beside the last line. The italic summary is set in a narrower column and is marked as a foot block here. Reading of "tradita" and "apocrypha,," is doubtful.
